      "snippet": "Yes—on Android we can do that reliably by indexing the download destinations, not by trying to “hook” the apps.
On most phones, both ChatGPT downloads and browser downloads land in:

/sdcard/Download (primary)

sometimes /sdcard/Documents (secondary, device-dependent)

So the correct solution is: auto-index these folders on an interval and write a manifest you can search instantly.
What you’ll have when done

Auto-updating manifest files:

/sdcard/Download/MetaBlooms/manifests/downloads_manifest"
